Dialog.Title: Drakkenheim Recipe
Dialog.Heading: Drakkenheim Recipe: {name}
Dialog.Existing: This item already has a crafting recipe: Apply will replace it.
Dialog.EditedHint: Regenerate will discard the lines you edited.
Dialog.EditsLost: Your edited lines were discarded by the regeneration.

Messages.ItemLocked: {name} belongs to a locked compendium: the item was not modified. Unlock the compendium or import the item to write the recipe on it.
Messages.ItemPermission: You lack permission to modify {name}: the item was not modified.
Messages.ApplyFailed: The recipe could not be applied: {error}
Messages.FabricateCreated: Fabricate recipe "{name}" created in "{system}" ({components} new components, {tools} new tools, {items} new items).
Messages.FabricateUpdated: Fabricate recipe "{name}" updated in "{system}" ({components} new components, {tools} new tools, {items} new items).
Messages.FabricateFailed: Fabricate: step {step} failed: {error}. The description, the flag and the Schematic were kept.
Messages.FabricateApi: Fabricate: incompatible version, nothing was written (missing: {missing}).

countsPermanent.name: Components per rarity (permanent items)
countsPermanent.hint: Five numbers (2 to 10), Common to Legendary, separated by slashes. Default: 4/4/5/6/7.

countsConsumable.name: Components per rarity (consumables)
countsConsumable.hint: Five numbers (2 to 10), Common to Legendary, separated by slashes. Default: 3/3/3/4/4.

schematicFolder.name: Schematics folder
schematicFolder.hint: Name of the Items folder where Schematics are created.

createSchematic.name: Create the Schematic by default
createSchematic.hint: Initial state of the "Also create the Schematic" box in the preview.

recipeLanguage.name: Language of the generated recipes
recipeLanguage.hint: Language of the Crafting paragraph and of the Schematic. English keeps the text consistent with the Drakkenheim module.

fabricateEnabled.name: Fabricate integration by default
fabricateEnabled.hint: Initial state of the "Also create the Fabricate recipe" box in the preview.

fabricateSystemName.name: Fabricate crafting system
fabricateSystemName.hint: Name of the Fabricate crafting system that receives the recipes; created if missing.

fabricateComponentFolder.name: Monster Components folder
fabricateComponentFolder.hint: Name of the Items folder where the generic components (Rare Bones, Rare Animus...) are created.

fabricateWorkshopFolder.name: Workshops folder
fabricateWorkshopFolder.hint: Name of the Items folder where the Workshop tools are created.

errors.wrongSystem: Drakkenheim Recipe Generator requires the dnd5e system.
